foot.name: Spire Foot
foot.desc: Ash falls like snow. An iron door to the north is locked. A key glows in the drift.

landing.name: Ash Landing
landing.desc: The stair turns. A door east leads into an armory. The flight goes on north.

armory.name: Armory
armory.desc: Racks of burned spears. One thick red vial survived.

stairwell.name: Last Stair
stairwell.desc: The last flight. A narrow sword leans where a sentry used to stand.

peak.name: The Peak
peak.desc: Wind and cinders. A lord sits on a throne of chimney brick.

spire_door.desc: The iron door is locked and warm.
spire_door.success_msg: The lock turns. Heat spills down the stair.
spire_door.fail_msg: The lock will not take what you offered.
